instruction.text: Schreibe das fehlende Wort in die Lücke.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1_chirp'>Never give up on your dreams is what my grandma always says.</voice>
atoms.b: “Never give up on your ((dreams)),” is what my grandma always says.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m1_chirp'>How have you found your passion in life?</voice>
atoms.b: How have you found your ((passion)) in life?

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f2_chirp'>I was born and raised here and could never imagine leaving my home town.</voice>
atoms.b: I was born and raised here and could never imagine ((leaving)) my home town.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_chirp'>My two best friends and I don't share many interests and still love to spend time together every day. </voice>
atoms.b: My two best friends and I don't share many interests and still love to spend ((time)) together every day.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_chirp'>Everyone in my friend group has a hobby except me, which makes me feel under pressure sometimes.</voice>
atoms.b: Everyone in my friend group has a ((hobby)) except me, which makes me feel under pressure sometimes.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m3_chirp'>Jermaine is the only person I know that reads poetry in his free time.</voice>
atoms.b: Jermaine is the only ((person)) I know that reads poetry in his free time.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_chirp'>I grew up with the English culture on my father's, and the Japanese culture on my mother's side.</voice>
atoms.b: I grew up with the ((English)) culture on my father's, and the Japanese culture on my mother's side.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>I think I will never give up trying to learn a backflip.</voice>
atoms.b: I think I will ((never)) give up trying to learn a backflip.

atoms.text: Ordne die Merkmale richtig in den Steckbrief ein.

instruction.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f1_chirp'>My best friend Camille is the greatest. She was originally born in Marseille, in France, so she speaks French and English fluently. She moved to England with her parents when she was twelve and lives in Manchester, like me. We met online, playing an online game. Apart from gaming, she loves hiking and playing the guitar. I would describe her as someone who sets themselves high goals and works for them confidently. Camille is also very creative. For some reason, she is incredibly invested in board games and loves to watch documentaries on history.</voice>
